title: Dinner Lady Sweets Watermelon Slices Shortfill E-Liquid
description: The fresh, mellow sweetness of watermelon gets the hard candy treatment in this mouth-watering vape from Dinner Lady with a gentle interplay between sweet and sour. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks.
